title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. A valid competing offer is EUR 33 per unit (offer:70240-1); please improve your complete package. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 80.8% (sc:70210@2026Q3).

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I checked your numbers and you make fair points about the material index and our delivery last quarter. I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR for 35 days lead time to beat that other offer, but we must keep payment at 30 days. We need the cash flowing to keep the shop running smoothly for you.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – updated package
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

thank you for your revised quote and for keeping 35 days lead time. A valid competing offer is EUR 30.5 per unit (offer:70250-1); please improve your complete package.

The attached sheet keeps your 30 days net, which supports your cash flow. It covers 4200 pc a year over 24 months, a steady base load for the free capacity you mentioned on your second shift. You told us Hollerau is an important reference customer, and we would like to build the HX series with you.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the shaft, for example in tolerances or lot size, is possible?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – updated package
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point.

Hallo, thanks for the volume details and keeping the 30 days payment, that helps us keep the machines running. Our Angebot is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

My guys will get back to you on the tolerances and lot sizes. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
